response.overview: Commissioned by Australian Paper Manufacturers, this documentary shows the process of paper manufacturing in the Boola Boola State Forest region of Gippsland, Victoria. It chronicles sustainable forestry methods and logging procedures alongside the replanting of seedling pines for future generation use. It features the residential area of Traralgon, the manufacturing process at the Maryvale Mill, and the everyday use of the final products.
response.title: The Eternal Forest
